name: Whisper Money
description: Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app for tracking accounts, categorizing transactions, and understanding spending patterns.

notes.text: Email is set to log output by default; configure RESEND_API_KEY and related mail settings in /opt/whispermoney/.env for production email features.
Open banking integrations require additional EnableBanking variables in /opt/whispermoney/.env.
